name: DNIS
description: Document Node Identity profile per SPEC-CORE §5.6 (which adopts SPEC-DNIS as a normative extension of §5 The Instance Model). Registers dnis:Document, dnis:Node primitive types and dnis:DerivedFrom, dnis:MigratedFrom relation types. The runtime adapter (src/core/dnis/adapter.ts) routes SPEC-DNIS Operations through Host primitive/relation APIs and workbooks OperationResult from the SPEC-CORE op log per §5.6.3.

metadata.description: The node tree as a numbered document, walked through parent_node_id and ordered by position.
